title: SCALE replication artifact: MoST measurements, additivity of Capacity Units and burst factor
description: Raw MoST (Measuring of Sustainable Throughput) results for three 7-8B LLMs served on NVIDIA A40 GPUs, together with the analysis code and outputs used in the evaluation of the SCALE paper: frequentist and Bayesian tests of the additivity of Capacity Units under request mixes, and the burst factor MIT/MST of every request class. Includes LaTeX assets (macros, tables, figures, draft section) and a static site (docs/) with an interactive statistical report and didactic animations that works offline.
notes: Run analysis/run_all.py to reproduce; open docs/index.html to browse the results offline.
